claim.quote: Finding no significant excess of events in the direction of the Cygnus constellation, we set an upper limit on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section of σSD−p < 6.65 × 10−36 cm2 at 90% confidence level.

key_value.note: 90% CL upper limit on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section; the WIMP mass at which it applies is not stated in the abstract.

name: First Directional Dark Matter Limits from the MIMAC μ-TPC Detector

summary.plain: MIMAC analysed years of unshielded data from two gas chambers at Modane, tracking recoil directions on a map of the Galaxy. It saw no excess in the Cygnus direction and set its first spin-dependent limit.
summary.technical: Two chambers with effective exposures of 495.1 and 354.2 days; 30 mbar 50% i-C4H10 / 50% CHF3; BDT track selection and ON/OFF analysis on the galactic map with a moving kinematic cut; limit on the spin-dependent WIMP-proton cross section 6.65e-36 cm^2 (90% CL); the abstract does not state the WIMP mass.

title: First Directional Dark Matter Limits from the MIMAC μ-TPC Detector
why_it_matters: The title calls these the first directional limits from MIMAC. A preprint (arXiv v1, July 2026); not yet peer reviewed as far as the sources read show.
